name: Camiguin Bulbul
rangeDescription: Camiguin sur (southern philippines)
description: A fairly large bulbul of forest and forest edge on Camiguin, where it is unmistakable. Dark olive-brown with a pale bill.

name: Itatiaia Spinetail
rangeDescription: High mountains of southeastern brazil (southern espírito santo to northeastern são paulo)
description: Small, plain, long-billed and long-tailed spinetail with a restricted range. Found in bamboo thickets and clearings in montane forests with grass and shrubs where it forages in the understory.

name: Medium Egret
rangeDescription: Japan to southern india and greater sundas
description: A stocky egret that is larger than Eastern Cattle and Little Egrets, but smaller than the Great Egret. Often confusing and difficult to identify, this bird is truly intermediate between potential confusion species.

name: Compact Weaver
rangeDescription: Patchily distributed from southwestern senegal and guinea-bissau eastward to southeastern sudan, eastern and southern south sudan, and western ethiopia southward to northern angola, southern democratic republic of the congo, rwanda, burundi, southwestern kenya, and northwestern tanzania
description: Has a typical weaver color scheme but an unusual shape: a chunky body, heavy bill, and short tail. Breeding males and females have a black mask, and the crown is yellow in males and black in females.

name: Golden-spotted Ground Dove
rangeDescription: Andes of southern peru to northwestern argentina and northern chile
description: Rather small and stocky dirt-colored dove of the high Andes. The namesake golden spots on wing coverts are hard to see.

name: Northern Parula
rangeDescription: Eastern north america (southern canada to southern usa); winters to nicaragua and west indies
description: Small, short-tailed warbler with a sharply pointed, bicolored bill. Blue-gray above with mossy-green patch on the back, white eye-arcs, and yellow breast.

name: Taiwan Thrush
rangeDescription: Mountains of taiwan
description: Uncommon endemic thrush breeding in montane forests (1000-2500 m). Male is striking: black with an orange belly and a snow-white head.

name: Thick-billed Parrot
rangeDescription: Mountains of western mexico (sierra madre occidental)
description: Very local, long-tailed, and social parrot of mountains in northwest Mexico. Feeds in pine and pine-oak forests.

name: Whitehead's Broadbill
rangeDescription: Montane forest of northern and central borneo
description: Magnificent emerald-green giant of a broadbill, with distinctive black mottling and streaking. Males have black streaking on the underparts which females lack.

name: Parkinson's Petrel
rangeDescription: Little and great barrier islands (new zealand); ranges to south america
description: A medium-sized, all-black petrel with a dark-tipped yellowish bill. Breeds only on Great Barrier and Little Barrier Islands in New Zealand.

name: Cape Spurfowl
rangeDescription: South africa (riverine scrub of southern and western cape province)
description: A large, mostly dark brown francolin with pale feather-edging that forms a fine scaly pattern on the body. It also has dull red legs and a mostly reddish bill with a dark top and yellow base.

name: Northern Carmine Bee-eater
rangeDescription: Savanna and grassland of sub-saharan africa
description: Large and gorgeous bee-eater with a mostly carmine body, and blue-green head and belly. The central tail feathers are elongated.

name: Velvet Asity
rangeDescription: Humid montane slopes of eastern madagascar
description: Dark, dumpy bird of the rainforest understory. Males are all black with green bare skin on the head in breeding plumage and black with yellow scaling in non-breeding plumage.

name: Kilimanjaro White-eye
rangeDescription: Northern tanzania (mount kilimanjaro, mount meru, and arusha regions)
description: A small, sharp-billed warbler-like bird, olive-yellow with very broad white spectacles around the eyes. Found in montane forest, forest edge, and lush gardens and scrub, usually in hyperactive flocks.

name: West African Batis
rangeDescription: Humid forest of sierra leone to southern cameroon and gabon
description: A classically patterned batis of forest, forest edges, villages, and towns in tropical lowlands and foothills. Males have white underparts bisected by a black chest band, mostly black upperparts with a broken white eye-line, white on the nape, scalloped white and gray on the back, and a white wingbar that extends to the tip of the wings in the secondary flight feathers.

name: Blyth's Pipit
rangeDescription: Southern siberia to mongolia, china, tibet, and northeastern india
description: A mid-sized pipit with pale brown plumage and a fine, dark bill. Strong streaking on the head, mantle, and back contrasts strongly with the pale edges of the feathers.

name: Yellow-crowned Tyrannulet
rangeDescription: Southwestern costa rica to northern bolivia, the guianas, and amazonian brazil
description: Small, small-billed flycatcher usually found in the canopy. Yellow belly with gray head and pale whitish eyebrow.

name: Striated Softtail
rangeDescription: Locally in eastern brazil (southern bahia to espírito santo and northern rio de janeiro)
description: Distinctive-looking rufous bird, heavily streaked with a bright cinnamon tail. Note the orange chin patch.

name: Tablas Drongo
rangeDescription: Philippines (tablas)
description: A medium-sized, long-tailed bird of forest canopy on Tablas, where it is the only drongo in range. Entirely black with glossy-blue wings, crown, and streaks on the neck and chest.

name: Flame Bowerbird
rangeDescription: Southern new guinea (toricelli and prince alexander mountains)
description: A very brightly-colored bowerbird of lowland and foothill forests in southern New Guinea. Male unmistakeable.
